prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Specify a Mac long-form note editor with read-only and editable states. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: macOS. Notes are rendered as screenshots, editing cannot select text and scroll position resets after formatting. Some notes are read-only but show an active insertion cursor; long URLs and mixed scripts occur.

criteria.task_completion: Define actual selectable/editable text, clear mode/selection/cursor behavior, layout and scroll preservation, standard editing and accessible long-content handling.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the text-views guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Define actual selectable/editable text, clear mode/selection/cursor behavior, layout and scroll preservation, standard editing and accessible long-content handling.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Define actual selectable/editable text, clear mode/selection/cursor behavior, layout and scroll preservation, standard editing and accessible long-content handling.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
